rounds.question: Which one cracks?

lines: It flexes and soaks up the shock

source: Sutanto et al., Communications Physics (2025), MIT

caption: Standing egg vs lying egg 🥚 Squeezed: a tie. Dropped: not even close. Which one did you pick? (MIT, 2025) What should we test next? 👇 #egg #physics #science #engineering #satisfying #mythbusting #3d
sources_detail: Sutanto, Cohen et al., 'Challenging common notions on how eggs break and the role of strength versus toughness', Communications Physics 8, 2025 (MIT)
Static compression to first crack: vertical 46.0 +/- 6.6 N, horizontal 45.2 +/- 5.5 N; 46.0/9.81 = 4.69 kg, 45.2/9.81 = 4.61 kg
Drop tests 8-10 mm: horizontal eggs cracked far less often than vertical ones (more compliant -> absorb more energy)
